title: Why don’t some movies change a character’s name when they cast an actor with the same name in the role?

commenti.body:
I work in the film industry - mainly as an editor, but I've sat in the director's chair for a couple of projects.

It really isn't a big issue. If anything, some actors I know find it easier to connect with their characters if they share the same name. Also, I've never heard anyone complain about a character having the same name of its actor.

It can also happen that a director or writer will write a character with a specific actor  in mind, and then name them as the person they imagine playing it. An example would be Jeffrey Lebowski, who the Coens always imagined portrayed by Jeff Bridges.
Very fascinating. That makes sense that it makes it easier to connect to the character. Thank you very much for your response.
